_doc: Phase 90.O RESERVED counterpart of learn_v1. Authored ONCE, sealed by the commit that introduces it, and run ONCE against the FROZEN candidate — never during development, never tuned against. Same scenario (teach -> correct -> change subject -> new session -> ask in other words) and the same six families, but different slots, different values, different phrasings and different distractors from the DEV set, so passing it is not a paraphrase of passing learn_v1. Criteria fixed here before any run; all values synthetic.
